verdict.rationale: Bitwarden is a password manager, not an AI agent or assistant, so acting as an MCP client that consumes other servers' tools does not fit this kind of product. The evidence shows only that Bitwarden publishes its own official MCP server (the server role), which is a separate story. Nothing shows Bitwarden can connect to or plug in external MCP servers, so the exception does not apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
